pages.title: Continuity Protocol
pages.text: Emergency EVA, issued after you lose your equipment in late Phase 6.

pages.title: Supplies
pages.text: $(li)$(bold)10 min$() reserve oxygen$(li)$(bold)15 min$() equipped thermal service$(li)Missing pieces reissued on return$(br2)$(danger)It's disposable.$() Every issued piece shares one service clock.

pages.title: Goal
pages.text: Recover a serviceable rig or return to recorded shelter.$(br2)$(flavor)Recorded locations do not constitute confirmation of habitable conditions.$()

pages.title: Navigation
pages.text: Press $(k:key.frozendawn.continuity_target) to switch the target.$(br2)$(bold)LAST SHELTER$(): set when you set your respawn at a bed or charged anchor.
The fix is degraded: follow the bearing, then search within $(bold)32 blocks$(). It stays the same across replacement issues.

pages.title: Last Telemetry
pages.text: Where your equipment was lost: a position, not proof it's still there. Later empty-handed losses keep the original destination.
Gear from the qualifying loss lasts $(bold)15 minutes$() while its area is ticking. Fire, lava and other hazards still apply.

pages.title: Service
pages.text: $(li)Inventory bars show service power$(li)HUD timer at 5 minutes left$(li)Breathable air saves oxygen, not power$(li)Impacts hurt you, not the service$(li)Seal wear shows at the visor edges

pages.title: At Zero
pages.text: $(danger)Thermal control, navigation and emergency armor end$(), and the issued pieces are removed.$(br2)A complete sealed normal EVA rig with usable oxygen retires the issue at once.
Removing every issued piece pauses service and life support.$(br2)Repair, cartridges and replacement issues can't refresh old equipment.
